shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json next.config.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx tsconfig.json && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!.next'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!.git'"' && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "cat components/request-metadata.tsx && ls -la && git diff -- package.json && node -p \"require('next/package.json').version\" && rg -n 'connection\\(|cacheComponents|unstable_noStore|dynamic|revalidate|fetchCache|Date\\.|Math\\.random|randomUUID|headers\\(|cookies\\(' app components next.config.ts && for path in /AGENTS.md /workspace/AGENTS.md; do if [ -f \""'$path" ]; then cat "$path"; fi; done'

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && git diff -- next.config.ts app/layout.tsx components/request-metadata.tsx && rg -n 'force-dynamic|force-static|unstable_noStore|revalidate|fetchCache|dynamic\\s*=' app components next.config.ts || test \""'$?" -eq 1'
